summary: Tested the new Checksheet feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend: 10 pytest cases in test_checksheet.py cover: seeded templates present, admin CRUD on checksheet-templates with create->list->update->delete verification, RBAC (user 403 on POST/PUT/DELETE templates), schedule checksheet save (admin persists items/operator/technician + signatures), user 403 on PUT /schedules/{id}/checksheet, user can read schedule w/ checksheet, 404 on missing schedule. All 10 passed. Frontend: Playwright verified admin sees Kelola Template + Tambah Jadwal + Checksheet buttons; opening checksheet dialog with template select populates rows; auto-suggest works (value=108 outside 6-8 -> not_ok; value=7 in-range -> ok); OK/Tidak OK summary counts update; add-row/remove-row work; operator/technician names + signature canvases fill; Cetak BAP triggers a PDF download (1 download event captured); Simpan Checksheet persists and reopen shows saved names. Template manager create+delete flow works. User (operator) login on /schedules shows Checksheet button but NO manage-templates, add-schedule, edit-schedule-*, delete-schedule-* buttons. Opening checksheet as user is fully read-only: no template select, no add-row, no save button, item cells are plain text (0 value inputs), and Cetak BAP is still available.

issues: DialogContent missing aria-describedby (a11y warning in console, non-blocking)
Canvas2D getImageData warning suggests setting willReadFrequently=true on SignaturePad canvas (perf, non-blocking)

critical_code_review_comments: ChecksheetDialog.suggestResult treats value='' -> parseFloat NaN -> keeps previous result; if user clears the value the auto not_ok/ok status is not reset. Consider resetting result to '' when value is cleared.

PUT /schedules/{id}/checksheet returns the whole schedule with checksheet, but list_schedules already returns everything - fine. However, ChecksheetData payload allows arbitrarily large base64 signature strings; consider size validation (e.g., <=200KB per signature) to prevent DB bloat.
TemplateManager delete uses window.confirm (native browser dialog) - consider AlertDialog for consistency with Schedules delete UX.
Old /app/backend/tests/test_simin_api.py still uses email-based login (obsolete) - will fail if run; update or remove for regression consistency.
seed_templates only seeds when collection is empty; no way to reseed after admin deletes them without manually clearing DB - acceptable but worth noting.

To run: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/test_checksheet.py -o addopts='' -v`.
